description: This file defines the IBinder interface class and related components for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including constants, methods, and nested classes for managing remote objects and their lifecycle.

classes.name: IBinder
classes.description: Base class and low-level protocol for remotable objects in Android's binder IPC system.

classes.name: IBinder::DeathRecipient
classes.description: Abstract class for receiving death notifications when a remote binder dies.

methods.name: queryLocalInterface
methods.description: Checks if this IBinder implements the interface with the given descriptor.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the canonical name of the interface provided by this IBinder.

methods.name: isBinderAlive
methods.description: Checks if the binder is alive.

methods.name: pingBinder
methods.description: Pings the binder to check if it is responsive.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps debugging information to a file descriptor.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves an extension interface if available.

methods.name: getDebugPid
methods.description: Gets the process ID of the binder for debugging.

methods.name: setRpcClientDebug
methods.description: Sets up RPC debugging with a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: transact
methods.description: Performs a transaction with the remote binder.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Registers a recipient to be notified if the binder dies.

methods.name: checkSubclass
methods.description: Checks if the object is a subclass of IBinder.

methods.name: attachObject
methods.description: Attaches an object to the binder for its lifetime.

methods.name: findObject
methods.description: Finds an attached object by its ID.

methods.name: detachObject
methods.description: Detaches an object by its ID.

methods.name: withLock
methods.description: Executes a function while holding the internal lock.

methods.name: lookupOrCreateWeak
methods.description: Looks up or creates a weak reference to a binder object.
